fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-01-17, the complainant reported repeated harassment by a neighbour over a minor road collision near Amudham Puram Apartment Complex. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-01-17 at about 11:20. Yogesh Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000359. Vignesh Subramani (mobile 9000000487) was named as a possible person of interest. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00003, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Access to the property reportedly obstructed repeatedly.
fields.Keywords: harassment, neighbour dispute, apartment complex, morning, suspect, mobile number, CCTV, photograph
